items.headline: Osborne throws and runs for scores, UConn bowl eligible with 29-21 win over Old Dominion
items.description: — Kalieb Osborne ran for a touchdown and threw for a score and UConn became bowl eligible with a 29-21 win over Old Dominion on Saturday night.

items.headline: Osborne, Bowers have 3 TDs, carry UConn past James Madison 46-22
items.description: — Kalieb Osborne threw three touchdown passes, Cyncir Bowers scored three times and Ky Wilson returned a kickoff 100 yards for a score to pace Connecticut in a 46-22 win over James Madison on Saturday.
